wiki.title: Patrick Snyder
wiki.extract: Patrick James Snyder (born October 10, 1956) is an American Republican politician and former radio host from Schofield, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 85th Assembly district since 2017. He also previously served as a member of the Schofield City Council, and worked as a legislative aide to U.S. Representative Sean Duffy.
